definitions.gloss: a broad, flat expanse of land
definitions.explanation: A large area of flat, open land with few trees or hills, often covered with grass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{平原|へいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{平原|へいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: Horses are running across the plain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地平線|ちへいせん}→地平線：03473_chiheisen⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{平原|へいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The plain spread out all the way to the horizon.

notes:
A broad, flat stretch of open land. A somewhat literary or geographic word; in everyday conversation ⟦{野原|のはら}→野原：14417_nohara⟧ (field) is more common for smaller open areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な{平原|へいげん}: a vast plain
- {平原|へいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: a plain spreads out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平野|へいや}→平野：00096_heiya⟧: plain — a geographic term for a low flat region, often named (such as ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧⟦{平野|へいや}→平野：00096_heiya⟧)
- ⟦{草原|そうげん}→草原：05035_sougen⟧: grassland — a plain specifically covered with grass
- ⟦{野原|のはら}→野原：14417_nohara⟧: field — a smaller, more familiar open area
